# Feature Request

## Description

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Motivation

Explain the problem or use case that this feature would address.

## Proposed Solution

Describe your suggested approach, if you have one.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you considered.

## Security Considerations

Explain whether the proposed change could introduce security, privacy, or system-safety considerations.

## Additional Context

Add any screenshots, examples, references, or other information that may help explain the request.
